annotation_scope.estimand: Agreement with released annotated instances under fixed matching, normalization and granularity
annotation_scope.ignore_regions: None inferred; no region/category filtering based on GT, semantic review or candidate output
annotation_scope.input_restriction: Models receive full PNG pixels only; GT boxes/text, review flags, dataset lexicon/vocab and sensitivity membership cannot filter, guide or decode predictions
annotation_scope.known_scope: Paper describes words and excludes equations/symbols; EDA observes inconsistent inclusion of math, logos and interface text; exhaustive word coverage unverified
annotation_scope.precision_interpretation: Precision relative to released annotations; not certified visible-text precision
annotation_scope.prediction_accounting: Every prediction counted; every unmatched prediction FP for released-label detection/spotting, even if it may represent real unannotated text
annotation_scope.ranking_limit: Different annotation coverage or detection of real unlabelled text can affect ranking; detection diagnostics do not remove that bias
annotation_scope.recall_interpretation: Recall of annotated instances; not all visible text

claim: Study-specific end-to-end localization/transcription against released XML; not the paper's query-by-string/example retrieval mAP task or an official leaderboard reproduction; descriptive EDA-exposed course-held-out released-label agreement

cohort.duplicate_review: no exact duplicate frames; all 469 dHash candidates reviewed different within that queue only
cohort.independence: course/video folders are unverified source proxies

rule.hold_rationale: Whole-frame exclusion prevents silently converting an invalid labelled region into an unlabelled region while retaining other predictions; no validated ignore mask exists
rule.integrity_failure: Unexpected source hashes/counts or EDA discrepancy hard-stop freeze; never silently reduce the expected denominator
rule.keep: Decoded PNG and parsed paired XML; every box satisfies 0 <= xmin < xmax <= PNG width and 0 <= ymin < ymax <= PNG height; every normalized transcription nonblank; difficult flag exactly 0
rule.metadata_only_repair: Use decoded PNG width/height for derived evaluation metadata; preserve raw XML, all coordinates and text; no scaling, clipping or extrapolation
rule.pool: All 1,755 native test PNG/XML pairs in the pinned release

execution_gate.configuration_selection: reuse pinned candidate defaults/configuration without test tuning; no GT-based prediction filtering
required_before_any_inference: test cohort/GT/policy/protocol and candidate binding verified
pinned model files/config/source hashes and locked runtime loading verified
run identity binds source pixels, test freeze, weights, decoder, preprocessing, thresholds, grouping and failure schema
execution_gate.status: pending_candidate_runtime_loading_validation; no spotting inference in this freeze

failures.duplicate_or_extra_frame_id: hard reject run; do not silently deduplicate or filter
failures.frame_error: retain frame denominator; no partial predictions; every GT is FN; zero predictions
failures.malformed_record: hard reject schema; do not discard malformed records to improve metrics
failures.missing_record: convert to frame error missing_record; report in failure ledger
failures.recognition_error_with_valid_detection: retain polygon and empty transcription; detection may match, spotting cannot match nonblank GT
failures.resume: reuse only records bound to identical input/cohort/protocol/config/source/model identities; never mix run identities
failures.retry: at most one retry for recorded transient I/O/transport failure before committing a frame; no score-based retry or best-of selection; log all attempts
failures.successful_empty_frame: status ok, zero predictions; all GT FN; distinguish from engine failure

geometry.coordinate_origin: raw zero-origin image coordinates; no VOC minus-one shift and no inclusive plus-one area
geometry.gt: raw XML xmin,ymin,xmax,ymax; continuous rectangle edges, width=xmax-xmin, height=ymax-ymin
geometry.invalid_prediction: retain in prediction count as FP for both endpoints; no clipping, convex-hull or automatic repair
geometry.iou: true polygon intersection area divided by union area
geometry.prediction: simple polygon in original decoded-frame coordinates; preserve quadrilateral geometry
geometry.resize: candidate adapter must invert all resize/padding transforms before scoring
geometry.valid_prediction: at least 3 vertices, finite numeric coordinates, positive area, no self-intersection, within 0..width and 0..height

matching.detection: maximum-cardinality one-to-one bipartite matching on IoU > threshold
matching.determinism: sort GT by object_id, predictions by polygon string then raw text; adjacency by decreasing IoU then prediction index; deterministic augmenting paths
matching.duplicates: each GT and prediction used at most once; unmatched duplicate detections are FP
matching.granularity: no one-to-many or many-to-one credit; merged/split predictions penalized
matching.interpretation: independently optimized detection and spotting matches are not an additive recognition-error decomposition
matching.spotting: independent maximum-cardinality one-to-one matching with IoU > threshold AND exact normalized transcription equality

metrics.aggregation: sum TP/FP/FN across frames before calculating each primary score; never mean frame F1

primary_uncertainty.interval: sort N differences; lower at floor(0.025*N), upper at floor(0.975*N)-1, zero-based; no interpolation
primary_uncertainty.limitation: few course proxies and uncertain dependence; exploratory conditional intervals, no generalization/power claim
primary_uncertainty.method: paired nonparametric cluster bootstrap; sample K cluster IDs with replacement per replicate, retain whole clusters
primary_uncertainty.pairing: same frame IDs and cluster assignments for both candidates; no complete-case removal of failed frames
primary_uncertainty.rng: Python random.Random(seed).choice(sorted IDs), fresh RNG for each endpoint/grouping
primary_uncertainty.statistic: candidate B minus A pooled micro spotting Hmean, recomputed from resampled TP/FP/FN totals

required: unweighted mean of per-course spotting Hmean and detection F1; retain seven course counts
primary plus observed_flag_frame_influence; both denominators and candidate B-minus-A differences
review flags are separate post-scoring diagnostics, never candidate inputs

secondary_uncertainty.interval: sort N differences; lower at floor(0.025*N), upper at floor(0.975*N)-1, zero-based; no interpolation
secondary_uncertainty.limitation: few course proxies and uncertain dependence; exploratory conditional intervals, no generalization/power claim
secondary_uncertainty.method: paired nonparametric cluster bootstrap; sample K cluster IDs with replacement per replicate, retain whole clusters
secondary_uncertainty.pairing: same frame IDs and cluster assignments for both candidates; no complete-case removal of failed frames
secondary_uncertainty.rng: Python random.Random(seed).choice(sorted IDs), fresh RNG for each endpoint/grouping
secondary_uncertainty.statistic: candidate B minus A pooled micro spotting Hmean, recomputed from resampled TP/FP/FN totals

metrics.selection: descriptive differences only; no generalized/production winner; report ranking sensitivity rather than choose favorable endpoint
sensitivity: same cohort and predictions at IoU > 0.75
same cohort and predictions with case-sensitive normalization at IoU > 0.5
metrics.zero_denominator: precision=0 if no predictions; recall=0 if no GT; Hmean=0 if neither GT nor predictions; always retain counts

scientific_sources.supports: Section III word annotation seeded by TextSpotter and edited in LabelImg, equations/symbols excluded, course partition; Section V-B IoU > 0.5. Does not certify present XML correctness or our Hmean endpoint
ICDAR2015 localization plus transcription evaluation background; our matching/normalization/ignore policy remains explicitly study-specific

Northcutt et al. 2021: test-label errors can alter benchmark comparisons; motivates transparent raw-label primary and bounded influence diagnostic, not automated correction or a CVID error-rate estimate
Nosek et al. 2018: distinguish analysis choices declared before outcomes from post-hoc exploration; this local freeze is not an external registration

semantic_flag_sensitivity.limits: Diagnostic influence of known reviewed frames only, not corrected GT, a label-noise bound, a random estimate or proof remaining labels are clean; three frames carry 40 GT objects, only four sampled objects are flagged
semantic_flag_sensitivity.name: observed_flag_frame_influence
semantic_flag_sensitivity.reporting: Always publish alongside primary with exact changed denominator and candidate differences; never select whichever endpoint favors a candidate
semantic_flag_sensitivity.rule: Exclude entire geometry-eligible test frames containing any uncertain or apparent_disagreement object in the already completed 72-object EDA sample; freeze IDs before spotting outcomes
semantic_flag_sensitivity.scoring: First validate/score full primary prediction set; aggregate retained whole-frame rows, without modifying predictions or GT; retain failures in remaining frames

source.annotation_creator_qc: not_certified; semantic flags and selective coverage preserved explicitly
source.granularity: one released XML object; no merging or splitting words/lines
source.ground_truth: XML object bbox and original object/name transcription
source.redistribution: preserve raw images and derived transcriptions locally; no new publication or sharing authorized

text.case_sensitive_sensitivity: NFKC and split/join whitespace without casefold
text.do_not_care: none; native test difficult flags are 0; literal * and selective labels retained as released
text.lexicon: none; dataset vocab/lexicon, GT strings and recognition predictions cannot be decoder inputs
text.primary: Unicode NFKC, casefold, split/join whitespace; exact full-string equality
text.soft_text_matching: forbidden for primary Hmean; no CER tolerance, edit-distance threshold, dictionary correction or fuzzy credit
